kentucky.summary: Sunny, dry weather continues across Danville and the Bluegrass through Sunday under high pressure. Chilly clear nights favor patchy frost and localized river-valley fog, while daytime temperatures hold near 70. Monday begins in the middle 40s and warms into the lower 60s by the end of this 72-hour forecast.

days.label: Sunday

Sunday night stays clear and cool with a most likely low near 45°F; patchy fog may form in the most sheltered river valleys toward Monday morning. Monday then warms from the middle 40s into roughly 60–64°F by the end of the forecast period.

upstate.currentConditions: At 6:05 AM EDT, KCEU reported clear skies, 50°F, a 46°F dew point, calm wind and 10-mile visibility. At 5:55 AM, KLQK was clear, 38°F, with a 36°F dew point, calm wind and 10-mile visibility. The station contrast supports a deliberately broad overnight-low range. Tempest data was not used.

days.label: Friday

upstate.bottomLine: The Upstate stays dry and mostly sunny through Friday. Thursday is the warmest day; a dry northeast-flow wedge then lowers Friday temperatures and adds a modest breeze without producing hazardous wind or rain.
